note: Gobblegums (roadmap Phase 2). Rarity tiers in order, low to high. A pack needs packMin gums; each gum of a tier above the first needs supporting gums from the tiers below it, on a rising ladder like the perk prices: the k-th gum of a tier needs base + step*(k-1) gums below that tier in the pack. Gums are not consumed: the pack is reused every match. In a match you start with none and roll them at a terminal (GUMS app): price by rolls this round, at most rollsPerRound a round, hand of handSize.
